verdict.rationale: Snyk documents extensive fix capabilities beyond reporting: suggested fixes, automatic fix PRs for open-source vulns, an agentic Remediation Agent that applies and verifies fixes, and CLI/IDE slash-commands (`snyk fix --agentic`, `/snyk-fix`) to auto-apply patches (snyk-docs-5, snyk-docs-12, snyk-docs-13, snyk-docs-21, snyk-docs-23, snyk-docs-29, snyk-docs-30, snyk-docs-34, snyk-docs-14). However, independent hands-on community reports describe the automated fix-PR workflow as noisy and unreliable in practice — creating 'dozens or hundreds of PRs,' missing entire versions, or replacing legitimately forked packages, with users preferring Dependabot (snyk-comm-2, snyk-comm-7). Missing for 10: independent corroboration that the newer agentic/DeepCode autofix and Remediation Agent features (as opposed to the older OSS fix-PR flow) work reliably in real projects, and quantified accuracy/success-rate data beyond the vendor's own 85% claim.
